comment: Regression net for the auto-refresh of security-audit references. known_good = threat categories that MUST survive every refresh (their disappearance = regression = rollback). known_bad = strings that must NEVER appear (hallucinations caught in earlier runs = rollback). This is a REGRESSION NET, not a novelty gate: genuinely new categories are admitted via official-source citation in the verifier, not by matching this list. The verifier grows both lists over time (confirmed -> known_good, caught -> known_bad); this is only the seed.
